id: \bRuby: My name is Ruby. I'm able to bring out the inner beauty of any Pokémon and have mastered Pokémon Contests.
en: \bRuby: My name is Ruby. I'm able to bring out the inner beauty of any Pokémon and have mastered Pokémon Contests.
it: \bRuby: Mi chiamo Ruby. So far emergere la bellezza interiore di qualsiasi Pokémon e padroneggio le Gare Pokémon.

id: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Charmer.
en: \bBecause of that I've been given the title Charmer.
it: \bPer questo mi è stato conferito il titolo di Ammaliatore.

id: \bRuby: Your team was beautiful to watch in battle. Almost as perfect as mine.
en: \bRuby: Your team was beautiful to watch in battle.  Almost as perfect as mine.
it: \bRuby: È stato bello vedere la tua squadra in lotta.  Quasi perfetta quanto la mia.
